steps.label: Verify PR description references the linked issue and includes a test plan
Check that all new exported functions have JSDoc/godoc comments
Confirm unit test coverage for changed lines is at least 80%
Scan diff for hardcoded secrets, API keys, or debug console.log statements
Validate that error paths are handled and not silently swallowed
Review SQL queries for N+1 patterns and missing indexes
Ensure new dependencies are pinned and added to the SBOM allow-list
Check accessibility: ARIA labels, keyboard nav, color contrast on UI changes
Confirm migration scripts are reversible and tested on a copy of prod data
Run lint, typecheck, and full test suite locally before approving
